record.scope_reason: MISR is generic multimodal sentiment/emotion representation learning. Targeted results on physical page7 compare SIMS and CHERMA emotion categories, addressing imbalance and cross-modal conflict. It does not assess clinical conditions or mental-health outcomes. Some figure-axis glyphs are damaged in machine extraction; the task and results prose is readable and sufficient for scope.

record.title: ChuLo: Chunk-Level Key Information Representation for Long Document Understanding
record.scope_reason: ChuLo studies generic long-document understanding. Section4 physical page5 specifies Hyperpartisan News, unreliable-news LUN and EU-law Eurlex57k classification plus GUM and CoNLL NER. These are general news/legal/linguistic tasks rather than biomedical primary experiments.

record.title: REVS: Unlearning Sensitive Information in Language Models via Rank Editing in the Vocabulary Space
record.scope_reason: REVS unlearns sensitive email addresses, URLs and synthetic social-security-number information memorized by language models. It is general privacy/model editing, with no clinical or biomedical primary task.

record.title: Is External Information Useful for Stance Detection with LLMs?
record.scope_reason: The paper studies external-information bias in general stance detection. Section3.1 physical page2 includes COVID-19-Stance alongside political P-Stance and mixed SemEval2016 targets such as atheism, climate, feminism, Hillary Clinton and abortion. Health-related targets are only part of the mixed social/political benchmark, not biomedical-primary research.

record.title: Benchmarking Query-Conditioned Natural Language Inference
record.scope_reason: QC-NLI benchmarks query-conditioned entailment and inconsistency detection. Physical pages4–5 adapt SNLI image descriptions, RobustQA multi-domain passages, RAGTruth hallucinations and FactScore Wikipedia biographies. BioClaim is related work, not a primary experiment, and the actual new benchmark is generic.

record.title: Flowchart-Based Decision Making with Large Language Models
record.scope_reason: Flowchart-based decision making reconstructs dialogue paths from FloDial. Section3.1 physical page3 specifies2738 technical-support dialogues about cars and laptops and12 troubleshooting flowcharts. Expert knowledge and diagnosis language refer to equipment troubleshooting, not medicine.

record.title: NarGINA: Towards Accurate and Interpretable Children’s Narrative Ability Assessment via Narrative Graphs
record.scope_reason: NarGINA is a clinical-linguistic narrative-ability assessment candidate. Physical pages3–4 describe real children aged3–13 narrating a wordless picture book under clinical-linguistics guidance, expert scoring by clinicians/educators, and gold-standard narrative graphs; page6 evaluates the resulting Chinese narrative-assessment corpus. Its actual outputs are narrative ability scores and interpretable completeness/coherence traits, not validated disease diagnoses. The task is specifically motivated and designed for language-disorder assessment/intervention, rather than general essay scoring; retain as a medical-adjacent clinical-language candidate with this limitation.

record.title: Improving Efficiency in Large Language Models via Extendable Block Floating Point Representation
record.scope_reason: EES studies low-bit block-floating-point hardware and inference efficiency. Physical page6 evaluates OPT/Llama on HellaSwag, ARC and LAMBADA, with circuit power/area simulation. No biomedical primary task is present.

record.title: EpiCoDe: Boosting Model Performance Beyond Training with Extrapolation and Contrastive Decoding
record.scope_reason: EpiCoDe improves data-scarce model decoding. Section5 physical page5 specifies law(JEC-QA/DISC-Law-Eval), mathematics(GSM8K_zh) and logic(LogiQA), not biomedical domains.

record.title: NativQA: Multilingual Culturally-Aligned Natural Query for LLMs
